steps.message: Now let me verify it works in the repo.

Works as expected (empty descriptions here since it's a fresh repo). The alias is defined in `/root/.config/jj/config.toml`:

```toml
[template-aliases]
log_custom = 'change_id.short() ++ " | " ++ description.first_line() ++ "\n"'
```

Use it with `jj log -T log_custom` (add `--no-graph` if you want it without the graph prefix).
